name: Developmental Coxa Vara
definition: Developmental decrease in femoral neck-shaft angle causing proximal femoral varus, limp and progressive deformity in childhood.

investigations.principle: Pelvic radiographs define neck-shaft angle and Hilgenreiner epiphyseal angle.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Progressive deformity commonly requires valgus osteotomy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Asthi developmental phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Developmental decrease in femoral neck-shaft angle causing proximal femoral varus, limp and progressive deformity in childhood.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
